study_identification_part.si_4_title: Comparative analysis of cortical anatomy in male participants with internet gaming disorder or tobacco use disorder: Insights from normative modeling

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Healthy control data were obtained from the Brain Genomics Superstruct Project (GSP). Patient groups (IGD and TUD) were recruited locally at the Center for Cognition and Brain Disorders, Hangzhou Normal University.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: data of 665 male participants were downloaded from the Brain Genomics Superstruct Project (GSP)... 78 male individuals with IGD and 80 male individuals with TUD were enrolled in this study

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: GSP data served as the reference cohort to establish the normative model of cortical thickness development using 10-fold cross-validation. The local dataset (IGD and TUD) was used to quantify individual deviations and perform clinical comparisons.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: The normative range of the model in the HC group was estimated through 10-fold cross-validation and then applied to patients
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Ma2024.pdf.md: METHODS AND MATERIALS / Normative modeling

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: The normative model for cortical thickness (CT) used 665 healthy controls from the GSP dataset. While 10-fold cross-validation was used (implying training on approximately 598-599 subjects per fold), the exact N for a final training phase is not explicitly stated.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: HC n = 665 ... The normative range of the model in the HC group was estimated through 10-fold cross-validation

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Age statistics for the healthy control group (n=665) are provided in Table 1. All participants were young adults (19-35 years).

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: The study included only male participants in both the healthy control group and the addiction groups.
